name: Qase MCP
description: Lets AI assistants read and write Qase test cases, runs, results, defects and suites, report CI results, and search with QQL, for QA teams using Qase test management.

skills.name: Test Case Management
skills.description: Creates, updates, and deletes test cases, singly or up to 100 at once, along with suites, shared steps, and milestones.

skills.name: CI Result Reporting
skills.description: Reports CI test results to a Qase project in one composite call, recording a pass or fail outcome for each test case.

skills.name: Defect Triage
skills.description: Creates a defect for a failed test result in one composite call, linking it to the run where the failure happened.

skills.name: QQL Search
skills.description: Searches cases, runs, results, defects, and plans with Qase Query Language, such as all failed results from the last week.

skills.name: Project Context
skills.description: Returns a project's full structure in one call: suites, milestones, environments, users, and custom fields.
